## PolyCodeEval Result Submission

- Benchmark version: `pce-1.0`
- Level: `L0 / L1 / L2 / L3`
- Submission directory: `community-results/pce-1.0/<level>/<github-user>/<submission-id>/`
- Scoring mode: `correctness_only / full_quality / execution`

### Checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds exactly one new result submission directory.
- [ ] `submission.json` identifies my GitHub account and the evaluator commit.
- [ ] `evaluation/` is the unmodified PolyCodeEval output, including `summary.json`.
- [ ] The package contains no generated code, credentials, private data, or unnecessary files.
- [ ] Optional logs use an accepted text format and satisfy the size limits.
- [ ] I ran `scripts/submission/validate_submission.py` successfully.
- [ ] I understand that this entry will be labeled self-evaluated and maintainer-reviewed.
